models.name: gemma-4-26B
models.description: Primary chat and reasoning model. Gemma-4 26B MoE at Q8. Best response quality for user conversations, self-reflection, and complex analysis.

models.name: gemma-4-E4B
models.description: Fast lightweight model for high-frequency low-stakes tasks. Used for STM fact extraction and alignment scoring where speed matters more than depth.

models.name: gemma-4-31B
models.description: Large dense Gemma-4 31B, QAT UD-Q4_K_XL (~16G). Google's quantization-aware-training Q4 matches the previous Q8 quality at roughly half the RAM. Alternative to 26B MoE for tasks where dense attention is preferable. Not started by default. Measured ~25.7 GB resident at 64k context (2026-10-02, llama.cpp 11362); tool calling verified.

models.name: qwen36-35b
models.description: Primary code and codegen model. Qwen3.6 35B MoE at Q8. Used by StreamFactory for generating new processing stream code.

models.name: qwen36-27b
models.description: Qwen3.6 27B dense model at Q8. Alternative for chat, reasoning, and code. Not started by default.

models.name: qwen35-122b
models.description: Large Qwen3.5 122B MoE. For complex reasoning and large-context code tasks. Requires ~88GB RAM; not started by default.

models.name: qwen3-coder
models.description: Qwen3 Coder specialised for software engineering tasks. Large model, not started by default.

models.name: devstral-123b
models.description: Devstral 123B MoE. Long-context coding and instruction-following. Not started by default.

models.name: glm4
models.description: GLM-4.7 REAP 40B. Alternative reasoning model. Not started by default.

models.name: gpt-oss-120b
models.description: OpenAI OSS 120B. High-quality alternative for chat and reasoning. Not started by default.

models.name: qwen35-9b
models.description: Qwen3.5 9B dense at Q8. Quick agentic tasks — fast STM extraction, alignment scoring, and lightweight codegen. Not started by default.

models.name: gemma-4-12B
models.description: Gemma-4 12B instruct, UD-Q8_K_XL. Mid-size dense model: thinks before answering, tool calling verified (llama.cpp 11362). ~15.6 GB resident at 64k context.

models.name: gemma-4-31B-Q8
models.description: Gemma-4 31B instruct at Q8_0: higher-precision sibling of gemma-4-31B (QAT Q4). Tool calling verified; ~40 GB resident at 64k context, slowest to answer of the Gemma family.

models.name: gemma-4-31B-Q4_0
models.description: Gemma-4 31B instruct, plain Q4_0 quantization (an alternative to the QAT gemma-4-31B). Tool calling verified; ~26 GB resident at 64k context.

models.name: qwen38-27b
models.description: Qwen3.8 27B (hybrid, reasoning) at UD-Q6_K_M. Tool calling verified; ~25.6 GB resident at 64k context.

models.name: qwen38-27b-uncensored
models.description: Qwen3.8 27B abliterated (its refusal tuning removed) at Q6_K. Tool calling verified; ~25 GB resident at 64k context. Iyye's own rules still come from identity.md and the host.

models.name: qwen38-27b-tak
models.description: Qwen3.8 27B 'tak-reasoning' build in a compact quantization (8.4 GB file). Tool calling verified; ~12.3 GB resident at 64k context.

models.name: qwen35-4b-tak
models.description: Qwen3.5 4B 'tak-reasoning' build. Small and quick to load (~2.5 s); tool calling verified; ~4 GB resident at 64k context.

models.name: minicpm5-2b
models.description: MiniCPM5 2B at Q6_K_L. Smallest model here: loads in ~2 s, tool calling verified, ~4.8 GB resident at 64k context. Useful for smoke tests and quick checks.

models.name: muse-glimmer-30b
models.description: Muse-Glimmer 30B (28B params, muse-glimmer architecture) at UD-Q6_K_XL. Tool calling verified; ~25.4 GB resident at 64k context.

models.name: muse-glimmer-30b-heretic
models.description: Muse-Glimmer 30B 'heretic' fine-tune (refusal tuning removed) at Q6_K_L. Tool calling verified; ~23.4 GB resident at 64k context.

models.name: gorilla-openfunctions-v2
models.description: Gorilla OpenFunctions v2 (DeepSeek-Coder 7B based, 4k context per slot) at Q6_K. Answers chat, but does NOT make OpenAI-style tool calls through llama.cpp, so Iyye's tools will not work with it. ~12.8 GB resident.

models.name: antangelmed
models.description: AntAngelMed: medical-domain MoE (bailingmoe2, 256 experts x 3.4B, 8 active) at Q6_K, 84.5 GB file, 32k native context. Its chat template has no tool support. NOT load-tested (too large to test alongside another model); RAM figure is an estimate.
